evidence.quote: The Universal Media Bay (P50728-B21) is only available as an option for the 8SFF chassis and can only be populated in Box 1.

rules.message: Cached controllers require a listed capacitor or storage battery.

evidence.quote: Controllers with cache require either P02377-B21 HPE Smart Storage Hybrid Capacitor with 145mm Cable Kit or P01366-B21 HPE 96W Smart Storage Lithium-ion Battery with 145mm Cable Kit.

rules.message: Secondary riser requires two processors.

evidence.quote: If secondary riser is selected, then 2 Processors must be selected.

rules.message: Full-height secondary riser blocks slot 2 and limits cards to two.

evidence.quote: If secondary FH riser is installed, then primary PCIe Slot2 cannot be used, maximum 2 quantity of PCIe cards can be selected at Slot 1 and Slot3.

rules.message: 186–270 W CPUs require P48905-B21 heatsink and P48908-B21 fan kits.

evidence.quote: One or two processor(s) with TDP equal to or greater than 186W through 270W require High Performance Heatsink Kit (P48905-B21) and High-Performance Fan Kit (P48908-B21).

rules.message: Two CPUs at or above 271 W require the stated liquid cooling solution.

evidence.quote: Two processors with TDP equal or greater than 271W require Closed-loop Liquid Cooling Heat Sink Fan FIO Bundle Kit (P48906-B21) or Direct Liquid Cooling solution.

rules.message: 1600 W Platinum PSUs require 200–240 VAC.

evidence.quote: 1600W Platinum Power supplies only support high line voltage (200 VAC to 240 VAC).

rules.message: Field upgrade from fourth- to fifth-generation Xeon is unsupported.

evidence.quote: Field upgrade from 4th generation processors (x4xx) to 5th generation processors (x5xx) is not supported.

rules.message: Selected processor is supported only in a single-socket configuration.

evidence.quote: "U" processors (i.e. 6414U, 3408U, 3508U), 6421N, 5411N, 8581V and 8558U are only supported in single socket configuration.

rules.message: CPUs at or above 195 W require P47224-B21.

evidence.quote: Processors with TDP equal to or greater than 195W require Performance Heatsink (P47224-B21).

rules.message: CPUs at or above 300 W require both fan kits.

evidence.quote: Processors with TDP equal to or greater than 300W require both Redundant Fan Kit (P47219-B21) and Second CPU Fan Kit (P47902-B21).

rules.message: Selected CPU does not support Intel VROC NVMe.

evidence.quote: Intel® VROC NVMe feature is not supported with 4510, 4509Y and 3508U processors.

rules.message: PCIe slots 5–10 require two processors.

evidence.quote: Dual processors are required to support expansion card on PCIe slots 5-10.

rules.message: CPU2, NS204i-u or tertiary riser requires the second CPU fan kit.

evidence.quote: Second CPU Fan Kit (P47902-B21) is required when any following options are selected: Second processor, HPE NS204i-u Gen11 Hot Plug Boot Opt Dev, Tertiary riser kit (P49693-B21).
